safety_critical_path.definition: Code permitted to influence physical state, authority state, task completion, admission, or a controlled terminal decision.

managed_runtime_support.definition: Code outside the hard safety path that communicates only through bounded typed fail-closed adapters.

axioms.name: Predictable Finite-State Core
axioms.source_doctrine: NASA Power of 10 inspired safety-critical core
axioms.statement: The safety-critical execution path shall operate as a bounded predictable finite-state system with no dynamic memory allocation after initialization, no recursion, no hidden side-effect pointers, and no boundary input that has not been explicitly admitted.
axioms.tactical_posture: Structural stress shall not cause unbounded loops, memory exhaustion, silent state drift, or unreplayable authority transitions.

requirements.rule: Every loop has a static or configuration-bounded iteration ceiling.
Recursion is prohibited in the safety-critical execution path.
Buffers, queues, state containers, and work pools are prefilled or preallocated before consequential execution.
Boundary inputs use typed default-deny schemas.
Consequential state transitions are explicit, finite, receipted, and replayable.
Managed runtimes remain outside the hard safety path unless equivalent bounds are evidenced and promoted by the Human Architect.

axioms.name: Fold 7 Spatial Ceiling
axioms.statement: Every discrete business function shall contain no more than 60 source lines and every encapsulated executable module shall contain no more than 100 source lines.
axioms.tactical_posture: Spatial bounds force semantic density, reduce cross-module entanglement, and preserve a reviewable human and agent working set.

requirements.rule: Oversized routines are decomposed by responsibility rather than formatting evasion.
Modules do not evade ceilings through dynamic code injection or unbounded import side effects.
Any exception remains HOLD until explicit Human Architect disposition.

axioms.name: Agent-Validated Tracer-Bullet Inception
axioms.statement: An agent or model shall not claim a solution, recommend an implementation architecture, or admit work into the repository until it has compiled, executed, and validated a thin end-to-end slice in a live disposable sandbox.
axioms.tactical_posture: The builder acts as an accountable systems compiler and proves integration viability before the master repository absorbs the direction.

requirements.rule: The tracer crosses every critical seam required to prove the proposed direction.
The tracer includes at least one valid path and one fail-closed or negative path.
Inputs, outputs, configuration, environment, evidence, and artifact hashes are captured.
Conversational descriptions, partial code, mocked success, and operator-completed initialization do not satisfy the tracer requirement.
If the executing agent cannot validate the tracer, the direction remains HOLD rather than feasible-by-assertion.
The full build begins only after tracer admission.

axioms.name: Reusable Steel
axioms.statement: Simplicity shall preserve rigor. A hardened deterministic capability shall be packaged behind a narrow typed interface instead of being repeatedly rebuilt, copied, or replaced with prose orchestration.
axioms.tactical_posture: Work hard once, reuse the proven mechanism through adapters, and keep the system small without weakening evidence or failure behavior.

requirements.rule: Shared capabilities remain independently executable and model-agnostic.
MCP exposure uses a bounded adapter rather than duplicating or absorbing the sovereign tool.
Direct and MCP execution produce semantically equivalent decisions and receipts.
Repository-specific skills add repository-specific work and do not rename or thinly wrap baseline tools.
The simplest design satisfying every governing requirement is preferred.

axioms.name: Self-Explaining Operational Scaffold
axioms.statement: The system and each consequential module shall be documented, functionally scaffolded, wired, and evidenced well enough to explain operation, authority, troubleshooting, verification, and recovery without the original builder being present.
axioms.tactical_posture: Context saturation is an engineering failure mode. Operational meaning belongs in executable interfaces, receipts, and concise root documents rather than builder memory.

requirements.rule: Runbook.md contains operator-ready execution, observability, maintenance, troubleshooting, recovery, and verification procedures.
Agents.md defines authority, admission, interception, task, tool, failure, and escalation behavior.
SKILLS.md projects only executable skills with schemas, bounds, evidence, and invocation contracts.
Every consequential module identifies purpose, inputs, outputs, side effects, authority, failure states, evidence, and verification command.
Documentation does not claim unavailable, unbound, or unverified capability.

axioms.name: Reverse RCA and Cumulative Verification
axioms.statement: Verification is a dynamic cumulative constraint. After each task item, every previously good applicable gate shall be rerun. A regression stops work until Reverse RCA finds the evidenced initiating condition or lawful boundary, repairs the coupling, and closes regression testing down the causal chain.
axioms.tactical_posture: An output is a receipt of upstream admissions, authority transfers, state changes, and structural effects. Surface repair without causal closure is not completion.
axioms.causal_question: For this output to be true, what upstream effects admitted or caused it?

requirements.rule: Causal traversal follows only evidenced edges and does not continue speculatively past the last evidenced edge.
Gates and incidents receive stable identifiers.
A Cumulative Gate Ledger is maintained with no more than seven columns for single-agent execution.
A Reverse RCA Ledger is maintained with no more than seven columns for single-agent execution.
Supervised sub-agent execution authorizes and requires one eighth sub_agent_task_attestation column and cross-spectrum contradiction checking.
A repaired branch reruns its causal regression chain and every previously good applicable gate.
